name: Optical crystal awards
title: Engraved Optical Crystal Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved optical crystal awards: cubes, diamonds, towers, wedges and more, engraved with your logo and wording. Minimum order 2. Quotes within 24 hours.
intro: Optical crystal is perfectly clear, heavy in the hand and catches the light from every angle, which is why it suits awards that need to feel special. Choose from cubes, diamonds, towers, wedges and facetted shapes, then we engrave your logo and wording and send a proof before we start.
body: Optical crystal is the go-to for company awards because it looks premium without being fussy. The flat faces take engraving crisply, so logos and small lettering stay sharp, and most shapes come in two or three sizes so you can give a larger award to the overall winner.
Every award comes ready to present, and we email a proof of the engraving for you to approve before anything is engraved.
wording: With thanks for 10 years of dedication
Team of the Year, presented by Acme Ltd

faqs.q: What is optical crystal?
faqs.a: Optical crystal is a very clear, high-quality glass with no lead content. It is heavier and clearer than standard glass, so engraving and logos stand out well.

faqs.q: Can you engrave our company logo?
faqs.a: Yes. Send your logo as a PDF, EPS or SVG if you have one, or a large clear image. We set it up for engraving and show it on your proof.

faqs.q: Can we mix different crystal awards in one order?
faqs.a: Yes. The minimum order is 2 awards in total, and you can mix different awards and sizes.

name: Star awards
title: Engraved Crystal Star Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved crystal star awards for star performers, employee of the year and team awards. Your logo and wording engraved. Minimum order 2.
intro: Nothing says star performer like a star. Our crystal star awards range from rising stars and star columns to stars on bases, and every one is engraved with your logo and wording.
body: Star awards are the favourite for employee of the year, star performer and top sales awards. Many come in several heights, which makes it easy to present a set: a larger star for the overall winner and smaller ones for category winners.
Tell us the occasion and how many you need, and we will quote within 24 hours on working days.

faqs.q: Which star award is best for employee of the year?
faqs.a: Star columns and stars on bases are the most popular for the top award, as they stand tall and have a good engraving area for a name, title and logo.

faqs.q: Can each star have a different name?
faqs.a: Yes. On the quote form choose different wording on each award, and you get a box for each one.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum order?
faqs.a: The minimum order is 2 awards in total, and you can mix different stars and sizes.

name: Globe awards
title: Engraved Crystal Globe Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved crystal globe awards for international teams, export success and global milestones. Your logo and wording engraved. Minimum order 2.
intro: A crystal globe is the natural choice for international achievements, export awards and global teams. Our globes come on clear crystal bases, in rectangles and as paperweights, all engraved with your logo and wording.
body: Globe awards work well for export and trade awards, international sales teams, travel and tourism awards, and anniversaries for companies with a worldwide reach.
Most globes come in more than one size, so you can match the award to the achievement.

faqs.q: Where is the engraving on a globe award?
faqs.a: On the base or the flat face of the award, depending on the design. Each award page shows the engraving area and roughly how much wording fits.

faqs.q: Can we add a logo?
faqs.a: Yes. Logos are engraved alongside your wording and shown on your proof before we start.

name: Sports awards
title: Engraved Glass & Crystal Sports Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved crystal golf and football awards for clubs, leagues and golf days. Your club badge and wording engraved. Minimum order 2.
intro: Crystal golf balls, footballs and sports-themed awards for club presentations, golf days and league winners. We engrave your club badge and wording on every one.
body: Crystal sports awards feel a step up from metal trophies and last a lifetime. They suit end-of-season presentations, golf days, charity events and corporate sports days.
Need a set for winners, runners-up and best player? Mix sizes and designs in one order.

faqs.q: Can you engrave our club badge?
faqs.a: Yes. Send your badge as a PDF, EPS or SVG if you have one, or a large clear image, and we will show it on your proof.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we order for a presentation night?
faqs.a: We quote within 24 hours on working days, and awards are ready 10–14 working days after you approve the proof. Allow at least 3–4 weeks before your event.

name: 3D laser crystal awards
title: 3D Laser Crystal Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Crystal blocks and shapes designed for 3D laser engraving inside the crystal. Ask us about your logo or design. Minimum order 2.
intro: Clear crystal blocks, cubes and shapes designed for 3D laser engraving inside the crystal, so a logo or design appears to float within it. Tell us what you have in mind and we will confirm what is possible on your proof.
body: These awards are made for designs that look best inside the glass rather than on the surface: logos, buildings, products and portraits.
Send us your artwork or an idea of what you would like and we will advise on the best block and size.
wording: With thanks from all the team

faqs.q: What artwork do you need for a 3D design?
faqs.a: A logo as a PDF, EPS or SVG is ideal. For other designs, email us what you have and we will tell you what is possible before you order.

name: Crystal awards on bases
title: Engraved Crystal Awards on Bases | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved crystal awards mounted on bases: they stand proudly on a desk or presentation table. Your logo and wording engraved. Minimum order 2.
intro: Crystal awards mounted on their own base stand tall on a presentation table, desk or shelf. Choose from clear, black and coloured bases, then we engrave your logo and wording.
body: Mounted awards have real presence, which makes them a good choice for the headline award of the night, long service milestones and partner awards.
Many come in more than one size, so the overall winner can receive the larger version.

faqs.q: Where is the engraving on a mounted award?
faqs.a: Usually on the crystal itself, and sometimes on the base too. Each award page shows the engraving area.

name: Jade & clear glass awards
title: Engraved Jade & Clear Glass Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved jade glass and clear glass awards with polished edges: a classic look at a sensible price. Minimum order 2. Quotes within 24 hours.
h1: Engraved jade and clear glass awards
intro: Thick jade and clear glass awards with polished edges give a classic look at a sensible price, ideal when you need a set of matching awards. Rectangles, circles, peaks and facetted shapes, engraved with your logo and wording.
body: Jade glass has a soft green edge that sets off white engraving beautifully. Many designs come in several sizes and thicknesses, which makes it easy to build a set for winners and runners-up.
They are a popular choice for long service awards, staff recognition and club presentations.

faqs.q: What is jade glass?
faqs.a: Jade glass is thick float glass with a natural green tint that shows on the polished edges. It engraves cleanly and costs less than optical crystal.

name: Long service awards
title: Engraved Glass Long Service Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved glass and crystal long service awards for 5, 10, 25 years and more. Each name engraved, minimum order 2. Quotes within 24 hours.
intro: Mark 5, 10, 25 years and beyond with an engraved glass or crystal award your colleagues will keep for life. Each award carries the person's name, years of service and your company logo.
body: Many companies use one design in different sizes for each milestone, for example a smaller award for 5 years and the largest for 25. Most of the awards here come in two or three sizes to make that easy.
Choose different wording on each award on the quote form and you get a box for every name.
wording: In recognition of 10 years' loyal service
Thank you for 15 years of dedication

faqs.q: Can each award have a different name and number of years?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose different wording on each award on the quote form, and you get a box for each one.

faqs.q: Can we reorder the same award next year?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep your artwork and wording layout on file, so next year's awards match.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum order?
faqs.a: The minimum order is 2 awards in total, and you can mix different awards and sizes.

name: Retirement awards
title: Engraved Glass Retirement Awards & Gifts | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved glass and crystal retirement awards from the whole team, with the person's name, years and a message. Minimum order 2.
intro: Say thank you for a career well spent with an engraved crystal award from the whole team: their name, their years of service and a message to remember you by.
body: A retirement award is usually presented once, so it is worth choosing something with presence. Globes and awards on bases are popular, and diamonds and peaks catch the light beautifully on a shelf at home.
Retiring several people this year? Add them all to one quote and give each award its own wording.
wording: Happy Retirement, John. With thanks from all at Acme
Enjoy every moment of your retirement

faqs.q: Can you engrave a personal message?
faqs.a: Yes. Each award page shows roughly how much wording fits, and we lay it out neatly on your proof.

faqs.q: Do you engrave single retirement gifts?
faqs.a: Our minimum order is 2 awards in total, so we can't engrave a single gift on its own.

name: Employee of the year awards
title: Employee of the Year Awards, Engraved Crystal | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved crystal awards for employee of the year, star performer and staff awards nights. Your logo and each winner's name. Minimum order 2.
h1: Employee of the year and staff awards
intro: Planning a staff awards night? Our crystal stars, columns and flames make standout awards for employee of the year, star performer and every category in between, each engraved with the winner's name and your logo.
body: Most awards nights need a headline award and a set of category awards. A popular approach is one taller design for the overall winner and a matching smaller design for each category.
Add the awards to your quote, choose different wording on each, and enter each category and winner. If you don't know the winners yet, tell us the categories and send the names later.

faqs.q: We don't know the winners yet. Can we still order?
faqs.a: Yes. Get your quote and approve the designs now, then send the names when you have them. Allow 10–14 working days after you approve the final proof.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we order for an awards night?
faqs.a: Allow at least 3–4 weeks before the event. Awards nights are busiest from November to March, so earlier is better then.

name: Golf awards
title: Engraved Crystal Golf Awards for Golf Days | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved crystal golf awards and golf ball awards for golf days, society competitions and club championships. Minimum order 2.
intro: Crystal golf balls on bases, golf ball rectangles and golf-themed awards for golf days, society competitions and club championships, engraved with your club badge or company logo.
body: Golf days usually need a few prizes: winner, runner-up, nearest the pin and longest drive. Mix designs and sizes in one order to cover them all.
Corporate golf days are a great fit for logo engraving, with your company logo on every award.

faqs.q: Can you engrave our golf club badge?
faqs.a: Yes. Send it as a PDF, EPS or SVG if you have one, or a large clear image.

name: Football awards
title: Engraved Crystal Football Awards | Grimes Engravers
description: Engraved crystal football awards for player of the season, top scorer and end-of-season presentations. Your club badge engraved. Minimum order 2.
intro: Crystal football awards for end-of-season presentations: player of the season, top scorer, managers' player and more, engraved with your club badge and the winner's name.
body: Crystal awards make a presentation night feel special and last far longer than plastic trophies. Mix designs in one order to cover every award on the night.

faqs.q: Can each award have a different winner?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose different wording on each award on the quote form.

name: Corporate awards
title: Corporate Crystal Awards with Your Logo | Grimes Engravers
description: Corporate glass and crystal awards engraved with your logo for partners, clients, milestones and company events. Minimum order 2. Quotes within 24 hours.
h1: Corporate crystal awards with your logo
intro: Awards for partners, clients, company milestones and events, engraved with your logo. Trusted by organisations across Wales and the UK, from banks and broadcasters to councils.
body: Corporate awards work best when they carry your brand clearly. Send us your logo and we will set it up for engraving and show it on your proof before anything is engraved.
Ordering every year? We keep your artwork and layouts on file so repeat orders match exactly.
wording: In recognition of an outstanding partnership

faqs.q: Can you match our brand colours?
faqs.a: Engraving on glass and crystal is frosted white rather than coloured. Your logo is reproduced in that finish, which gives a clean, premium look.

faqs.q: Can you deliver to more than one address?
faqs.a: Every order is delivered. Tell us in the notes if awards need to go to different places and we will include that in your quote.
